summary_points: Procedure for hydraulic and mechanical performance testing of centrifugal pumps
Tests conducted on manufacturer's test stand using cold water
Pumps tested according to ISO 9906 specifications
Records and reports kept for at least 10 years
Tolerances based on pump power input, with specific values for different grades
Procedure for measuring bearing temperature of centrifugal pumps.
Tests conducted on manufacturers' test stand using cold water.
Records and reports to be kept for at least 10 years.
Balancing impellers according to DIN ISO 1940 T1.
Running tests include capacity, suction head, discharge head, speed, and power measurements.
The procedure is for liquid visible penetrant examination on components.
It covers personnel qualification, safety requirements, and penetrant system details.
Visible penetrant (color contrast) will be used for inspection.
The procedure describes a Liquid Visible Penetrant Examination (PT) according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
Test devices include UV-meter and reference blocks for sensitivity testing.
Surface preparation involves cleaning with solvent-based cleaner and drying before applying penetrant.
Penetrant is applied by spraying or brushing, followed by a dwell time of 10-30 minutes.
Developer is applied to form a thin white coating, indicating surface discontinuities through bleed-out.
Inspection requires a minimum light intensity of 1000 lx for adequate sensitivity.
Test results must be documented on part papers or with a separate test report.
Post-cleaning involves removing excess penetrant and drying the workpiece.
